sub: Every farmer and farm registered in the Jutyar app, from the server. Add, edit, block or delete farmers, rename or delete farms, print a support letter for a farmer, or the government report for any area.
k_crops_note: kinds of crop on the farms
k_blocked_note: cannot sign in to the app
empty_farmers: No farmer is registered yet. Farmers appear here when they sign in to the Jutyar app, or when you add one.
empty_farms: No farm is registered yet. Farms appear when farmers walk their fields in the app.
notes_hint: never shown to the farmer, up to 1,000 characters
notes_long: Notes can be at most 1,000 characters.
phone_taken: A farmer with this phone number already exists.
delete_note: Deleting a farmer also deletes all their farms, messages and listings, and signs them out of the app at once.
delete_farmer_text: This deletes the farmer and their {n} farms for good, and signs them out of the app.
block_text: They are signed out of the app at once and cannot sign in again until unblocked.
unblock_text: They can sign in to the app again.
farmer_gone: This farmer is no longer in the register
farmer_gone_text: Another staff member may have deleted them.
farm_gone: This farm is no longer in the register
name_bad: Write a name of 1 to 100 characters.
delete_farm_text: The farm, its cells and its readings are deleted for good. The farmer stays.
